privileged_info_for_vlm: The recruitment source must be named exactly 'TechCrunch'. The job position 'Experienced Developer' is a pre-existing record in the system. The applicant name must be 'Jane Tech' with the email 'jane@tech.com'. Success is defined by the 'Jane Tech' record being saved with both the 'Experienced Developer' job and 'TechCrunch' source correctly assigned.
